-- Upgrade lms_groups table
ALTER TABLE lms_groups
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS course_id INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS seats INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS manager_id INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS team_admin_id INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS org_name VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS admin_email VARCHAR(320) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS admin_phone VARCHAR(50) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS website VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS notes TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS order_id INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

-- Upgrade lms_group_courses table
ALTER TABLE lms_group_courses
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS seats INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS order_id INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

-- Drop old userId column from lms_group_seats and add new columns
ALTER TABLE lms_group_seats
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS member_name VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status ENUM('pending','active','revoked') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS enrollment_id INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS invite_token VARCHAR(128) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS accepted_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_invite_sent_at TIMESTAMP NULL;
